resources.string: Edits waiting to be sent or in conflict
Nothing is waiting to be sent
Your queued edit will be deleted and cannot be recovered
GitHub could not be reached. Add the edit to the queue so it is sent automatically when the connection is back? The file is checked for changes on GitHub before it is sent.
This file changed on GitHub after you started editing. Nothing is replaced without your confirmation. Red is what is on GitHub, green is your edit.
This file no longer exists on GitHub. You can recreate it with your version or drop it.
Difference between GitHub and your version
Your edit will be saved on top of the current GitHub version and the changes made by someone else will be replaced. Older versions stay in the commit history.
Your edit will be deleted and the GitHub version stays as it is.
The file changed on GitHub again, review the difference once more
An unsaved edit of this file was found (%1$s). Restore it?
An unsaved edit was found (%1$s), but the file changed on GitHub since then. Saving will open the conflict screen.
